subject: Mutual action plan and security handoff — SOC 2 / SIG / DPA questions
messages:
From: Tom Li <tom.li@cedarbank.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
Cc: Anna Brooks <anna.brooks@cedarbank.com>, legal@cedarbank.com
Date: 2026-08-29T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: MAP / security handoff — ask list and timelines

Vanessa,

Thanks for the demo yesterday. Procurement and legal are standing up our mutual action plan (MAP) and we need a clear list of security gates and delivery dates to hit our internal signature target of 2026-09-15. Specifically we need:

- SOC 2 Type II (latest report) or an evidence bundle that maps controls to your environment.
- SIG / CAIQ completed spreadsheet and substantiating evidence (attachments or Drive links).
- A DPA redline (we'll send edits but want to see your preferred clauses for data deletion, breach notification SLA, and subprocessors).
- Confirmation of data residency options and default data retention windows (logs, usage telemetry, and customer data). Any escrow/archival options for logs is a must-have for us (2 years).

Can you provide a short timeline (deliverables + owners) for these items by EOD Monday? Also tell us whether Redwood would accept a contract signature window ending 2026-09-15.

Thanks — Tom
Tom Li
Senior Procurement Manager
Cedar Bank

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
To: Tom Li <tom.li@cedarbank.com>, Anna Brooks <anna.brooks@cedarbank.com>
Cc: kimberly_park@redwood.com, marcus_lin@redwood.com, grace_oconnor@redwood.com
Date: 2026-08-29T11:08:00-07:00
Subject: Re: MAP / security handoff — ask list and timelines

Tom — thanks, noted. Draft MAP and proposed owners below; we can hit your 2026-09-15 signature target if we lock dates this week. High level plan (first pass):

1) SOC 2 evidence package (deliverable: SOC2 summary + control mapping PDF) — owner: Kimberly Park (Security) — ETA: 5 business days (2026-09-03).
2) SIG / CAIQ — owner: Marcus Lin (Solutions Eng) — deliver CAIQ spreadsheet + evidence index (Drive) — ETA: 7 business days (2026-09-06).
3) DPA redline exchange — owner: Legal (we'll loop in our counsel) + Vanessa (contract lead) — initial redline returned to you within 3 business days, concurrent negotiation window 5 business days.
4) Data residency & retention options — owner: Grace O'Connor (Customer Success) — default retention: 90 days for telemetry + 30/90/365 configurable data retention for customer payloads; logs/forensics archival options available (2y escrow via archive export). ETA: 2 business days for a written options sheet.

Attachments in this thread: a short index of security artifacts (see attachment stub). We will also provision a shared Drive folder for evidence and delivery notes.

If this plan works, I'll convert into a mutual action plan doc with milestone dates and assigned owners, and propose a review call Thursday morning to walk acceptance criteria.

-Vanessa
Vanessa Ortiz
Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: Tom Li <tom.li@cedarbank.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
Cc: marcus_lin@redwood.com, grace_oconnor@redwood.com
Date: 2026-08-30T08:24:00-07:00
Subject: Re: MAP / security handoff — ask list and timelines

Tom / team — quick technical notes to complement Vanessa's plan:

- SOC 2: Redwood holds a SOC 2 Type II covering our hosted platform (security, availability, confidentiality). We'll deliver a SOC2 summary + control-mapping PDF and an evidence index that links to artefacts stored in the shared Drive folder. Where Cedar needs control-level evidence (config screenshots, runbooks), we can provide redacted artifacts and owned-owner attestations.
- SIG / CAIQ: Marcus and I will populate the CAIQ spreadsheet; evidence will be a mix of document links and short attestation notes. Expect a CAIQ "answer + evidence link" pattern rather than full PDF dumps for every item.
- KMS / Keys: We support customer-managed keys via KMS integrations (AWS KMS / GCP KMS). For Private deployments, HSM integrations can be scoped.
- Data residency: Hosted defaults to US regions; we can offer EU residency on Private or Dedicated deployments. For your stated need, we recommend Private (VPC) if you require EU data residency and long-term log custody.
- Logs / escrow: We can provide an export process for logs (S3 export or encrypted archive) on a scheduled cadence; retention to 2 years is operationally possible via archive export — we'll add an action item to nail the mechanics.

Attaching: SOC2-summary-POV.pdf (summary), CAIQ-evidence-index.csv (stub). We'll post the full artifacts to the Drive folder after internal approvals.

-Kimberly Park
Security Lead, Redwood Inference

From: Tom Li <tom.li@cedarbank.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
Cc: Anna Brooks <anna.brooks@cedarbank.com>, legal@cedarbank.com
Date: 2026-08-31T10:17:00-07:00
Subject: Re: MAP / security handoff — ask list and timelines

Vanessa / Kimberly — appreciate the clarity. A couple follow-ups before we finalize the MAP: 

- Can you commit to the dates above as milestones in the MAP (SOC2 by 9/3, CAIQ by 9/6)? Procurement needs those hard dates to align approvals.
- For the DPA we will circulate our redline (legal@cedarbank.com). Please confirm you can return a counter-redline within 3 business days of receipt.
- Escrow/export: Can Redwood run an automated monthly export of logs to a Cedar-owned S3 bucket (encrypted) to meet our 2-year retention requirement? If yes, list the expected format & retention controls.

If we get firm commitments on those bullets, we can keep the signature target of 9/15. We'll schedule the acceptance criteria review for 9/02.

Thanks — Tom

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
To: Tom Li <tom.li@cedarbank.com>, Anna Brooks <anna.brooks@cedarbank.com>, legal@cedarbank.com
Cc: kimberly_park@redwood.com, marcus_lin@redwood.com, grace_oconnor@redwood.com
Date: 2026-09-02T14:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: MAP / security handoff — ask list and timelines

Tom — confirmed and converting into an action-trackable MAP. Key commits below (we'll post a one-page MAP doc to Drive and update HubSpot):

- SOC 2 evidence package — deliverable: SOC2-summary-POV.pdf + control mapping — owner: Kimberly Park — delivery: 2026-09-03 (commit).
- SIG / CAIQ — deliverable: CAIQ spreadsheet + evidence index in Drive — owner: Marcus Lin — delivery: 2026-09-06 (commit).
- DPA redline exchange — receipt expected 2026-09-02; Redwood counter-redline committed within 3 business days (ETA 2026-09-07). Owner: Vanessa (contracts) + Redwood legal.
- Logs export / escrow — we will set up a monthly encrypted export to a Cedar-owned S3 bucket (format: gzipped JSONL with metadata headers; retention controlled by your lifecycle rules). Owner: Engineering + CS — action: engineering to confirm export template by 2026-09-04.
- Acceptance criteria review call — scheduled 2026-09-09 10:00 AM ET (inv to follow).

Milestones and owners will be added into the MAP doc and linked to HubSpot (Deal RWD-CE-482). We've attached the three artifact stubs in this thread; full artifacts will land in Drive once legal has signed the share grant.

Next steps for Cedar: send DPA redline to legal@redwood.com and confirm S3 bucket ARN for export. We'll queue the engineering task for the export template and confirm back by 9/04.

Regards,
Vanessa Ortiz
Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference

Attachments (referenced): SOC2-summary-POV.pdf (summary stub), CAIQ-evidence-index.csv (spreadsheet stub), DPA-redline_v3.docx (placeholder)
